newsitem.title: USA: Mobile Telecom unit in Argentina purchase.
newsitem.headline: Mobile Telecom unit in Argentina purchase.

text.p: Mobile Telecommunications Technologies Corp on Monday said its Mtel Latin America Inc subsidiary agreed to buy Argentina-based paging company RadioMensaje SA for $16 million in cash and $16 million in assumed debt.
RadioMensaje is co-owned by Motorola Inc's International Development Corp, BGH SA and Argentina- based Jacobel SA, Mtel said in a news release.
The deal, to be completed by June 27, would be funded directly by Mtel Latin America, which would merge its Argentine unit into RadioMensaje to create a paging company with 70,000 units in service.
Mtel provides wireless messaging services worldwide.
